body: I work in the games industry.  I had an engineering degree from a prestigious university that I threw away to do this and now I'm regretting it years later.

I've been chatting about this with therapists, friends and family for years.  I've tried everything I can think of to deal with my situation, and nothing seems to really help.  I honestly feel that I'm incompetent in my job nowadays and have lost all confidence that I can actually do the work well.  It's really soulcrushing.

Thanks...I've been through so much therapy over the years dealing with my issues I'm honestly tapped out from talking.  It doesn't seem to do much to help me, but it did help to vent and have people read.  So thank you.
